passage.label: sky split open responded Lord obligated; earth extended cast out within relinquished responded Lord obligated; O mankind laboring toward Lord great exertion will meet it

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدۡحٗا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ

mainSubject.label: The sky splitting open and responding to its Lord as obligated, the earth extended casting out what is within it and relinquishing it while likewise responding to its Lord; mankind addressed as labouring toward their Lord with great exertion and destined to meet that labour

subordinateSubjects.label: Responding to its Lord as obligated to do so
Casting out what is within it and relinquishing it
The earth likewise responding to its Lord as obligated
Mankind labouring toward their Lord with great exertion and destined to meet it

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Human life framed as exerted labour toward the Lord that will be met

relationships.label: Sky and earth both responding to their Lord as obligated at the dissolution

notes: Wave 12 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the labour-toward-the-Lord address (6) before the two-record contrast opens (7); P2 ends with the Lord-was-Seeing correction (15) before the twilight-night-moon oaths begin (16); P3 runs through the state-after-state declaration, prostration refusal, concealed-knowledge affirmation, punishment tidings and the believing exception (16-25).
